description: Either NAND or NOR, with the falsity constant, represents every finite truth function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.single_gate_complete (k : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GateKind) (n : ℕ)
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TruthFunction n) :
  ∃ A, ∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation (Fin n)), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v A = f v
